decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the approved Hero V is the fixed geometry and that the surrounding type and accent must adapt to it.
A same-message MODIFY already records the approved Hero V as the fixed reference for achieving the shared peak horizon.
The decision to preserve the Hero V while adapting surrounding type does not change the second V's established relative height or subordinate visual role.
The accent is already required to derive literally from the approved Hero V geometry, so treating that Hero V as fixed introduces no new state.
The shared-terminal state already requires the exact signature gesture from the approved Hero V; the source does not alter that treatment.
The second V is already derived from the approved Option 2 Hero V, and the source does not change its geometry, reach, or derivation rule.
Preserving the Hero V as the fixed reference does not change the requirement that kerning make the wordmark read as one unified mark.
The source concerns letterform geometry and alignment, not the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The source does not change the obligation to provide design rationale with review rounds.
The Hero V geometry decision has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
